description: Scala source code defining the DataFrameNaFunctions class for handling missing data operations in Spark DataFrames, including methods for filling, dropping, and replacing nulls or missing data.

classes.name: DataFrameNaFunctions
classes.description: Provides methods for handling missing data in Spark DataFrames, such as fill, drop, and replace operations.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Drops rows with nulls based on minimum non-null criteria and specified columns.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills nulls with specified values of various types (Long, Double, String, Boolean) for the entire DataFrame or specific columns.

methods.name: fillMap
methods.description: Fills nulls based on a map of column names to replacement values.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces specified values in a column or columns with new values, supporting generic types.

methods.name: buildDropDataFrame
methods.description: Constructs a DataFrame to drop nulls based on columns and minimum non-null criteria.

methods.name: buildFillDataFrame
methods.description: Constructs a DataFrame to fill nulls with a literal value for specified columns.

methods.name: buildReplaceDataFrame
methods.description: Constructs a DataFrame to replace values in specified columns.

methods.name: buildReplacement
methods.description: Converts a replacement map into a sequence of Replacement protobuf messages, converting numeric types to Double where appropriate.

methods.name: convertToDouble
methods.description: Converts supported numeric types to Double, throws exception for unsupported types.
